units.summary: Architecture audit + upstream decision: CI-2 closure verified (7abd15f ancestor of main d6ef917 via PR #34; follow-up branch sync merge 3980992 pushed+verified; PR = manual owner action), agents-js source inspection (1.10.1 Apache-2.0, 41 plugins, fork-based job runtime), minimal-reuse decision: @livekit/rtc-node 1.2.3 + existing livekit-server-sdk 2.20.0 (explicit AgentDispatchClient) for the observer; framework/Agno/LangGraph/CrewAI/Python/ASR adoption rejected or deferred with reasons; reproducible 6/6 probe (bun scripts/ci3-probe-upstream.ts); charter + research doc + licence BOM + THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES committed; lint + 1339/0 suite green; dependency delta +1 package (Apache-2.0).

Agent registry + domain-pack foundation: typed fleet registry (19 charter roles w/ must-never wiring, dynamic subject-expert resolution against pack state), versioned specialist contracts (charter §12 envelope contract 1.0.0, strict Zod, honesty rules C1–C6), domain-pack schema+validator (V1–V8; VERIFIED refuses without human review + passing benchmark), source/licence registry (§7.2 classes, superseded refusal), ISCED-F 2013 taxonomy adapter (36 families, honest matchedOn/no-match), profession catalogue at licence gate, 4 seed packs IN_REVIEW (mathematics/computing STANDARD, finance ELEVATED, health HIGH_STAKES). 39 new tests; suite 1378/0; lint clean; pushed+verified b6cc80e.

Fleet dispatcher + bounded worker pool on a durable per-agent task queue: ClassroomFleetTask model (taskKey UNIQUE = DB-guaranteed idempotency, CAS claims, lease+heartbeat recovery, honest skipReason, charter §12 terminal vocabulary, contractVersion + validated outputJson persisted; migration 20261124070000_ci3_fleet_tasks), task roles/priorities (CORE<MANDATORY_AUDIT<DOMAIN_SPECIALIST<LANGUAGE<ENRICHMENT; enrichment yields first under backlog>50 backpressure measured once per claim pass), worker.ts bounded pool (executor seam — no runtime fails honestly; claim-time consent re-check + role pre-resolution against pack state; envelope identity binding; lease recovery; session cancellation; pool stats; FLEET_WORKER_CONCURRENCY default 4 clamped 1–32), dispatcher.ts (planFleetTasks deterministic: auditor+guardian + learner+teacher-judge ALWAYS planned, subject experts only via taxonomy→dispatchable packs capped 3 with honest no-match skip, language only on real multilingual evidence — none before CI-3D and the plan records it, enrichment default-on/excludable; dispatchFleetForSession guards + P2002 race → alreadyQueued; dispatcher imports seed packs), registry register() now takes Zod INPUT type — fixes 19 pre-existing tsc TS2345 errors on main (CI runs bun x tsc --noEmit). 24 new isolated-DB tests; suite 1420/0; tsc clean; lint clean; pushed+verified c3be302 (branch fast-forwarded to main d64df69 first per hygiene rule 8). Note: this unit was originally implemented in a lost sandbox worktree (uncommitted); it was faithfully REBUILT from the milestone spec against current main — the rebuild is the shipped implementation, verified end-to-end.

LiveKit observer adapter: ClassroomObserverSession model (liveClassSessionId UNIQUE = one visible observer per room, DB guarantee; observerIdentity 'bean-observer:<id>' never a bean: student identity so webhook attendance accounting can never count it; honest transcriptionEnabled=false + canPublishMedia=false provenance columns; eligibility snapshot persisted; migration 20261124080000). Least-privilege VISIBLE token (roomJoin-only, canSubscribe/canPublish/canPublishData=false, hidden=false, disclosed name + metadata disclosure). Adapter on @livekit/rtc-node (autoSubscribe:false — no media reaches the observer) behind a narrow room seam; explicit teacher dispatch + withdraw route (GET/POST/DELETE /api/teach/classes/:id/live/observer) with ALL charter §11 Phase 0 checks server-side (LIVE room, approved owner teacher, current CI consent, one-per-room, global pool bound BEAN_CI_OBSERVER_MAX_ACTIVE clamped 1–16 default 4, provider configured) and honest typed 403/404/409/503 outcomes; terminal-row CAS reset enables honest re-dispatch; lifecycle wiring: live/end route + room_finished webhook fire-and-forget cancelObserverForEndedSession (observer leaves a finished class; failure can never affect attendance/booking/completion — criterion 6). Runtime honesty: consent re-checked at dispatch, every connect attempt and every heartbeat (mid-class withdrawal → leaves immediately, CANCELLED/consent_withdrawn); bounded connect attempts with exponential backoff → FAILED/connection_failed with bounded explanation; stale rows → FAILED/server_restart via recoverStaleObserverSessions; reconnect accounting reuses the webhook's clamped pure functions (never negative, never double-counted, gaps recorded); single-flight finalisation persists one strictly-validated identity-free evidence envelope (presence samples / evidence gaps / dataMessageCount / whiteboardSnapshotVersion only). 23 new tests (isolated real DB + deterministic fake-room seam): eligibility matrix, dispatch durability + identity proofs, consent withdrawal before connect and mid-class, reconnect/gap accounting, evidence contract (literal STRUCTURED_ONLY, bounded samples), decoded-JWT grant audit, capacity bound, stale recovery, failure isolation. CI-4 integrity re-verified IN SOURCE: ledger CI-4 COMPLETE/IN_SYNC (PR #42, a6c8d33, SATISFIED), 27/27 unique entries; 12 packs all declared IN_REVIEW (1 HIGH_STAKES health, 1 ELEVATED finance, 10 STANDARD); curator VERIFIED remains derived-only from checksum-bound distinct human approvals via requireAdmin-only append path; TRANSCRIPTION structurally UNSUPPORTED (z.literal(false) observer guard + no-op measurement + refused approval); fleet auto-dispatch default-off (exact 'true' only). CRITICAL DISCOVERY (language.ts): capabilityStore is a module-level in-memory array — measurements/approvals lost on restart/deploy/instance change/concurrent workers/DB restore; recordHumanLanguageApproval has ZERO production call sites (rg-proven); recordCapabilityMeasurement mints VERIFIED from a caller-supplied humanApproved flag with no reviewer/qualification/binding (self-certification hole). CI-5E contract set: DB-backed measurement/review/status/qualification/history separation with the exact binding + structural rules. Tests tests/unit/ci5-baseline-audit.test.ts 18 (ledger integrity, packs, curator binding, transcription gates incl. attack attempts, dispatch flag, behavioural restart-loss proof, self-certification-hole proof, source guards). Honest limits: no real human reviewers in the sandbox — all CI-5 workflow exercises use clearly-labelled synthetic fixtures; packs stay IN_REVIEW, language capabilities stay LIMITED/unmeasured until genuine qualified review.

Expert reviewer identity & qualification (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-REVIEWER-GOVERNANCE.md): ExpertReviewerProfile + append-only ExpertReviewerEvent (additive migration 20261125120000, schema validated). Strict lifecycle APPLICATION_PENDING → QUALIFICATION_REVIEW → APPROVED → ACTIVE with SUSPENDED/REINSTATED/EXPIRED/REVOKED/REJECTED — REVIEWER_TRANSITIONS table enforced (illegal transitions 409, terminal states refuse), suspension/revocation reasons required (≥10/≥20), lazy EXPIRED on read with SYSTEM attribution + renewal path EXPIRED→QUALIFICATION_REVIEW. Categories: DOMAIN_EXPERT (approvedDomains = registered pack domainIds) and BILINGUAL_LANGUAGE (approvedLanguages = [{tag,tasks[],domains?[]}] — tags from the 11-language catalogue; TRANSCRIPTION refused at every scope write and false in the pure matcher, structural §9.2 rule preserved). Scope matchers reviewerCanReviewDomain/Language (Mathematics≠Engineering, Hindi≠Tamil, domain-language restriction enforced). Self-review impossible (server-resolved admin actor refuses own profile). APPROVED requires authorised scope + verification result ≠ UNVERIFIED + stated qualifications; minimal verification results only (DOCUMENT_REVIEWED/REFERENCED_VERIFIED — no identity documents, no government ids stored). Reviewer-proposed scope advisory (payload); authoritative scope columns admin-write-only; strict application schema refuses forged scope/verification fields (400). APIs: POST /api/ci5/reviewers/apply (any signed-in account), GET /api/ci5/reviewers/me (owner-only), GET /api/admin/ci5/reviewers + POST /api/admin/ci5/reviewers/[profileId]/action (requireAdmin; BEGIN/DECIDE/ACTIVATE/SUSPEND/REINSTATE/REVOKE/UPDATE_SCOPE). tests/unit/ci5-reviewer-governance.test.ts 22 tests (isolated real DB via migrate deploy; route-level guards incl. 401/403/golden/forged-body refusals). Honest limits: no real reviewer profiles/qualifications exist in this deployment — fixtures only; registry starts empty.

Review assignment & case management (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-REVIEWER-GOVERNANCE.md §10): ExpertReviewAssignment + append-only ExpertReviewAssignmentEvent (additive migration 20261125130000). Server-authorised creation gates: reviewer ACTIVE, exact scope match (DOMAIN_PACK via reviewerCanReviewDomain; LANGUAGE_CAPABILITY via reviewerCanReviewLanguage tag+task+domain), mandatory admin COI check (CONFLICT_FOUND refuses), one open assignment per reviewer+subject, decided-version independence guard (checksum). Lifecycle ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→SUBMITTED→COMPLETED (outcomeRef to the authoritative ledger; SYSTEM-attributed completion) + RECUSED (reason ≥10, owner-only) / EXPIRED (lazy, SYSTEM, late submit refused) / CANCELLED (reason) / REASSIGNED (reason; replacement validated through the SAME gates BEFORE the original closes — a failed reassignment never leaves a subject silently unassigned). Assignments carry NO decisions — decisions stay in the append-only ledgers. detectReviewDisagreement flags approval-vs-objection pairs; both opinions preserved, never averaged, never silently favourable; resolution = independent adjudicator assignment (adjudication never mutates the ledgers). Routes: admin queue GET/POST, reassign, cancel (requireAdmin); reviewer own-queue, start, recuse (requireStudent, owner-only). tests/unit/ci5-review-assignments.test.ts 18 tests (isolated real DB; route guards via real requireAdmin/requireStudent; fixture reviewers: mathematics/engineering domain experts + Tamil/Hindi/Gujarati bilingual, all synthetic).

Human domain-pack validation (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-DOMAIN-VALIDATION.md): promotion path qualification-gated — recordPackReview refuses APPROVED without server-computed qualifiedApproverIds (ACTIVE reviewer scoped to the exact domain from the CI-5B registry via qualifyingApproverIdsForDomain); admin knowledge-pack route computes the set server-side per call; administrators retain conservative work-states (REJECTED/CHANGES_REQUESTED/RE_REVIEW_REQUESTED) and can never substitute for an expert. Structured A–F expert rubric (domain scope, knowledge accuracy, source provenance, educational value, safety, benchmark quality) with per-section OK/ISSUE/NOT_ASSESSED + notes; decision-vs-rubric consistency enforced in code (APPROVED ⇒ every section OK; REJECTED ⇒ ≥1 ISSUE; work-states ⇒ concrete findings); rubric evidence JSON stored INSIDE the append-only ClassroomPackReview evidence field — CI-4C ledger remains the single authority with checksum binding + terminal rejection + derived VERIFIED unchanged. Expert submit route POST /api/ci5/reviewer/assignments/[assignmentId]/pack-review: ownership + lazy expiry, ACTIVE-profile required for ANY submit, checksum freshness re-check (never review an uninspected version), assignment SUBMITTED→COMPLETED with outcomeRef=reviewId, ledger-refused submissions return to IN_PROGRESS with SYSTEM-attributed event. Independent adjudication route POST /api/admin/ci5/adjudications: ACTIVE scoped adjudicator distinct from every disagreeing reviewer, real disagreement required, completes exactly once, ADJUDICATED event audit-only (never mutates the decision ledgers or curated status). detectReviewDisagreement runs on every recorded decision — both opinions preserved, never averaged, never silently favourable. HIGH_STAKES two-distinct-QUALIFIED-reviewer rule proven (same reviewer cannot be re-assigned a decided version). tests/unit/ci5-domain-validation.test.ts 11 tests; tests/unit/ci4-curator.test.ts updated for the strengthened gate (8 tests, incl. negative no-evidence/unqualified-set cases). Honest state: zero real decisions — all 12 packs remain IN_REVIEW; every fixture reviewer is synthetic and clearly labelled.

Durable language governance (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-LANGUAGE-GOVERNANCE.md) — the CI-5A critical discovery CLOSED: LanguageBenchmarkMeasurement + LanguageCapabilityReview + LanguageCapabilityStatus (additive migration 20261125140000) replace the process-local capabilityStore. Measurements persist with full binding provenance (languageTag/task/domain/dialect/modelProvider/modelVersion/benchmarkVersion/benchmarkChecksum, idempotent unique binding, honest case counts, passed=true requires every case passed); machine evidence records at most LIMITED (pass AND fail recorded honestly). The humanApproved self-certification flag and the in-memory recordHumanLanguageApproval function are REMOVED — VERIFIED exists ONLY via recordLanguageCapabilityReview with a qualified ACTIVE BILINGUAL_LANGUAGE reviewer (exact tag/task/domain scope from the CI-5B registry), bound to the EXACT persisted measurement, with the 13-facet bilingual evidence checklist (meaning preservation, terminology, grammar, naturalness, script correctness, mathematical notation, scientific symbols, code-switching, register, dialect differences, ambiguity, unsupported claims, safety/refusal accuracy — APPROVED requires every facet OK). A new model/benchmark version is a NEW binding that must earn its own measurement+approval; the old VERIFIED binding becomes SUPERSEDED (pointer preserved, never silently extended, never downgraded by benchmark re-runs). Revocation is reason-required and history-preserving (review rows + approval count survive; re-approval refuses). TRANSCRIPTION is structurally unreachable at every layer (measurement 422, review refused, no status row possible, effective resolution hard-UNSUPPORTED, scope-write refusal in CI-5B) — the §9.2 gate is intact. The specialist runtime now reads the DURABLE refusal resolution with an honest fallback to the catalogue defaults. Restart durability PROVEN (second PrismaClient on the same DB sees identical VERIFIED state). Routes: admin benchmark-run+persist, admin durable capabilities view, admin revoke, reviewer language-review submit through an assignment. tests/unit/ci5-language-governance.test.ts 16 tests; ci3-language (16) and ci4-language (6) updated to the durable path with unchanged semantics. Full suite 1648/0 across 115 files. Honest state: zero real measurements and zero real bilingual reviewers — all VERIFIED/REVOKED states in tests are clearly-labelled synthetic fixtures on isolated DBs.

Expert-labelled benchmark programme (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-BENCHMARK-RESULTS.md): ExpertBenchmarkDataset + ExpertBenchmarkCaseLabel + ExpertBenchmarkRun (additive migration 20261125150000). 12 charter task kinds and 9 existing agent kinds vocabulary-enforced — no new agent personas were added; the programme measures the agents CI-1–CI-4 already built. Immutable dataset versions (slug+version unique) with deterministic sha256 content checksums and licence records (BEAN-AUTHORED-ORIGINAL or recorded compatible licence). Strict split separation: DEVELOPMENT/CALIBRATION/VALIDATION/BLIND_HOLDOUT — blind-holdout labels are refused through the open path (sealed until scoring) and holdout case keys are masked in the admin view; leakage prevention is structural (the module imports nothing from retrieval/domain-pack content). Expert reference labels append-only per reviewer: expected result + accepted alternatives (multiple acceptable answers first-class) + prohibited conclusions + supporting sources + confidence + ambiguity notes; two differing labels for one case are BOTH preserved (never averaged, never silently favourable — proven with a deliberate fixture disagreement); labelling requires an ACTIVE reviewer scoped to the dataset domain/language. Metrics honest by construction: method + sample size + expert-labelled sample + deterministic-only sample + accuracy (null when nothing scored) + prohibited-conclusion violations + exclusion notes — a percentage is never published without its basis; ran=false (no adapter) recorded as a first-class outcome; NO SELF-CERTIFICATION proven structurally (no governance-write imports) and behaviourally (post-run pack-review ledger empty, language capability unchanged). Regression comparison across model versions refuses non-runs and cross-datasets, states the delta with both sample sizes and records the CI-5H regression policy. Routes: admin datasets/runs/compare, reviewer labelling. tests/unit/ci5-benchmark-programme.test.ts 11 tests. Honest state: 0 real expert-labelled datasets, 0 real measured runs (no model credentials — every model-dependent number would be fabricated); all numbers in the doc are isolated-DB fixture numbers, stated as such.

Classroom pilot + reviewer UI (docs/BEAN-CLASSROOM-INTELLIGENCE-CI5-CLASSROOM-PILOT.md + CI5-REVIEWER-UX.md): ClassroomReportAuditReview (additive migration 20261125160000); privacy-masked evidence view built server-side at read time (student names/emails/private messages/individual academic histories/unrelated profile details masked, class metadata separated from teaching evidence, six UNOBSERVABLE dimensions marked honestly — spoken explanations, question handling, interactions, comprehension, tone/pronunciation, discussion quality — reviewers never asked to guess); audits checksum-bound (stale refuse 409; corrections are NEW rows; Evidence Auditor findings preserved verbatim; report status never edited); CLASSROOM_REPORT assignment subject type (ACTIVE reviewer with any approved scope; assignment = authorisation for the restricted masked view — no ownership bypass; teacher disputes untouched in the existing Trust workflow); clearly-labelled synthetic pilot fixture via the admin route. Governance UI: AdminCi5GovernancePanel at #/admin/ci5-reviewers (reviewer registry + lifecycle actions, assignment queue, durable language capability grid, benchmark registry, audit register) and Ci5ReviewerWorkspace at #/reviewer (own profile + scope, assignments with start/recuse, A–F pack rubric form, 13-facet bilingual checklist, masked-view report audit) — real backend APIs only (no mock data, no fabricated qualifications/metrics; server refusals surfaced verbatim), BEAN design system, 44px touch targets, aria-labelled controls, tablist semantics, responsive from 320px. tests/unit/ci5-report-audit.test.ts 8 tests; full suite 1667/0 across 117 files. Honest state: no real report audited by a real reviewer yet — the pilot fixture is synthetic and clearly labelled.
